title: 이나: 커피나 차, 두 시간이나
objective: By the end, you can join two nouns with 이나/나 to offer a choice, and add 이나/나 to a number to say that it is a lot. You can choose between 이나 and 나 by looking at the last sound of the noun.
summary: Learn the particle 이나/나 for giving a choice (A or B) and for showing that an amount is more than expected.

task.title: Use 이나 and 나
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, order, or write the Korean using 이나 or 나.

forms.form: Noun (ends in a consonant) + 이나 + Noun
forms.when: Use 이나 when the first noun ends in a consonant (has a final sound).
forms.means: A or B. One of the two is fine.
forms.exampleMeaning: Shall we have bibimbap or naengmyeon for lunch?

forms.form: Noun (ends in a vowel) + 나 + Noun
forms.when: Use 나 when the first noun ends in a vowel (no final sound).
forms.means: A or B. One of the two is fine.
forms.exampleMeaning: On weekends I usually watch a movie or a drama.

forms.form: Number + counter (ends in a consonant) + 이나
forms.when: Use after an amount, time, or count that ends in a consonant.
forms.means: As many as / as long as. The speaker feels the amount is a lot.
forms.example: 비가 와서 버스를 한 시간이나 기다렸어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: It rained, so I waited for the bus for a whole hour.

forms.form: Number + counter (ends in a vowel) + 나
forms.when: Use after an amount, time, or count that ends in a vowel.
forms.means: As many as. The speaker feels the amount is a lot.
forms.exampleMeaning: The child ate three apples — that many!

watchOut: 물나 (X) → 물이나 (O): 물 ends in a consonant, so use 이나.
커피이나 (X) → 커피나 (O): 커피 ends in a vowel, so use 나.
빵을이나 우유 (X) → 빵이나 우유를 (O): Do not put 을/를 before 이나. Put it after the last noun.
열 개나를 (X) → 열 개나 (O): After an amount with 이나/나, do not add 을/를.
exercises: Write 이나 or 나 in each blank: ① 지하철____ 택시를 타세요. ② 우유____ 주스를 사 올게요. ③ 우리 집에서 고양이를 세 마리____ 키워요.
Fill in the blank with 이나 or 나: 택시가 안 와서 삼십 분____ 기다렸어요.
Choose the correct sentence (a or b): a) 토요일을이나 일요일에 만나요. b) 토요일이나 일요일에 만나요.
Choose the meaning (a or b): 어제 친구가 전화를 열 번이나 했어요. a) My friend called about ten times. b) My friend called ten times, and I think that is a lot.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 가요 / 공원에 / 주말에 / 도서관이나
Answer in Korean using 녹차, 콜라, and 이나/나. End with 마실래요: 뭐 마실래요?
answers: ① 이나 ② 나 ③ 나
주말에 도서관이나 공원에 가요. (도서관이나 공원에 주말에 가요.)
녹차나 콜라를 마실래요. (녹차나 콜라 마실래요. / 콜라나 녹차를 마실래요.)
